Product page: 200-210C @50-100mm/s, 210-240C @100-200mm/s; retraction 0.8-1.2mm @30-40mm/s. Shore (HA/HD) 80. Drying/fan/enclosure from SUNLU wiki filament-category page (https://www.sunlu.com/wiki/filament-category). Wiki: fan ON, drying 50C (no hours). Weight options 0.25/0.5/1/2/3/5kg.
